3:198 · 003 Ali Imran

لَـٰكِنِ ٱلَّذِينَ ٱتَّقَوْا۟ رَبَّهُمْ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتٌ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا نُزُلًا مِّنْ عِندِ ٱللَّهِ ۗ وَمَا عِندَ ٱللَّهِ خَيْرٌ لِّلْأَبْرَارِ

Word in this verse: نُزُلًۭا — a hospitality

English (Sahih International): But those who feared their Lord will have gardens beneath which rivers flow, abiding eternally therein, as accommodation from Allāh. And that which is with Allāh is best for the righteous.

English (Yusuf Ali): On the other hand, for those who fear their Lord, are Gardens, with rivers flowing beneath; therein are they to dwell (for ever),- a gift from the presence of Allah; and that which is in the presence of Allah is the best (bliss) for the righteous.

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): لیکن جو لوگ اپنے پروردگار سے ڈرتے رہے ان کے لیے باغ ہے جن کے نیچے نہریں بہہ رہی ہیں (اور) ان میں ہمیشہ رہیں گے (یہ) خدا کے ہاں سے (ان کی) مہمانی ہے اور جو کچھ خدا کے ہاں ہے وہ نیکو کاروں کے لیے بہت اچھا ہے

18:102 · 018 Al-Kahf

أَفَحَسِبَ ٱلَّذِينَ كَفَرُوٓا۟ أَن يَتَّخِذُوا۟ عِبَادِى مِن دُونِىٓ أَوْلِيَآءَ ۚ إِنَّآ أَعْتَدْنَا جَهَنَّمَ لِلْكَـٰفِرِينَ نُزُلًا

Word in this verse: نُزُلًۭا — (as) a lodging

English (Sahih International): Then do those who disbelieve think that they can take My servants instead of Me as allies? Indeed, We have prepared Hell for the disbelievers as a lodging.

English (Yusuf Ali): Do the Unbelievers think that they can take My servants as protectors besides Me? Verily We have prepared Hell for the Unbelievers for (their) entertainment.

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): کیا کافر یہ خیال کرتے ہیں کہ وہ ہمارے بندوں کو ہمارے سوا (اپنا) کارساز بنائیں گے (تو ہم خفا نہیں ہوں گے) ہم نے (ایسے) کافروں کے لئے جہنم کی (مہمانی) تیار کر رکھی ہے

18:107 · 018 Al-Kahf

إِنَّ ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ كَانَتْ لَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتُ ٱلْفِرْدَوْسِ نُزُلًا

Word in this verse: نُزُلًا — (as) a lodging

English (Sahih International): Indeed, those who have believed and done righteous deeds - they will have the Gardens of Paradise as a lodging,

English (Yusuf Ali): As to those who believe and work righteous deeds, they have, for their entertainment, the Gardens of Paradise,

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): جو لوگ ایمان لائے اور عمل نیک کئے ان کے لئے بہشت کے باغ مہمانی ہوں گے

32:19 · 032 As-Sajdah

أَمَّا ٱلَّذِينَ ءَامَنُوا۟ وَعَمِلُوا۟ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَلَهُمْ جَنَّـٰتُ ٱلْمَأْوَىٰ نُزُلًۢا بِمَا كَانُوا۟ يَعْمَلُونَ

Word in this verse: نُزُلًۢا — (as) hospitality

English (Sahih International): As for those who believed and did righteous deeds, for them will be the Gardens of Refuge as accommodation for what they used to do.

English (Yusuf Ali): For those who believe and do righteous deeds are Gardens as hospitable homes, for their (good) deeds.

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): جو لوگ ایمان لائے اور نیک عمل کرتے رہے اُن کے (رہنے کے) لئے باغ ہیں یہ مہمانی اُن کاموں کی جزا ہے جو وہ کرتے تھے

Open on Quran.com

37:62 · 037 As-Saffat

أَذَٰلِكَ خَيْرٌ نُّزُلًا أَمْ شَجَرَةُ ٱلزَّقُّومِ

Word in this verse: نُّزُلًا — (as) hospitality

English (Sahih International): Is that [i.e., Paradise] a better accommodation or the tree of zaqqūm?

English (Yusuf Ali): Is that the better entertainment or the Tree of Zaqqum?

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): بھلا یہ مہمانی اچھی ہے یا تھوہر کا درخت؟

Open on Quran.com

41:32 · 041 Fussilat

نُزُلًا مِّنْ غَفُورٍ رَّحِيمٍ

Word in this verse: نُزُلًۭا — A hospitable gift

English (Sahih International): As accommodation from a [Lord who is] Forgiving and Merciful."

English (Yusuf Ali): "A hospitable gift from one Oft-Forgiving, Most Merciful!"

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): (یہ) بخشنے والے مہربان کی طرف سے مہمانی ہے

Open on Quran.com

56:56 · 056 Al-Waqiah

هَـٰذَا نُزُلُهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلدِّينِ

Word in this verse: نُزُلُهُمْ — (is) their hospitality

English (Sahih International): That is their accommodation on the Day of Recompense.

English (Yusuf Ali): Such will be their entertainment on the Day of Requital!

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): جزا کے دن یہ ان کی ضیافت ہوگی

Open on Quran.com

56:93 · 056 Al-Waqiah

فَنُزُلٌ مِّنْ حَمِيمٍ

Word in this verse: فَنُزُلٌۭ — Then, hospitality

English (Sahih International): Then [for him is] accommodation of scalding water

English (Yusuf Ali): For him is Entertainment with Boiling Water.

Urdu (Fatah Muhammad Jalandhari): تو (اس کے لئے) کھولتے پانی کی ضیافت ہے
